section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a study examining factors influencing intuitive eating among Chinese adolescent girls. The study demonstrates indirect effects of online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences on intuitive eating through broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation. The section discusses implications for intervention programs and highlights that broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation may serve as protective buffers against negative impacts of objectification experiences.
